item.title: Rallying Cry – June 11, 2026
item.description: The World Cup kicked off in Mexico with Shakira and cheering fans, while a tiny, adorable moon robot named LEV-2 is set to explore the lunar surface, and NASA’s Deep Space Network proved its resilience for Artemis II.
